Failed installs discard only the staging directory created by that invocation, preserving any previous `--force` installation and never following symlinks during rollback or `okf vendor remove`.

knowledge\architecture\security-boundaries.md-66-- **Archive extraction**: every entry is checked lexically and through symlinks before anything is extracted, so an archive is applied in full or not at all.
knowledge\architecture\security-boundaries.md-67-- **Staged installs and rollback**: `okf pull` and `okf restore` extract and validate in a fresh staging directory under `.okf`, then move it into place. A failed install discards only that staging directory. Rollback never removes a directory this invocation did not create, and never follows a symlink. `okf vendor remove` re-resolves its target and unlinks a symlink instead of following it.

23	  --min-score <N>    Gate minimum bundle quality score (0-100; aborts installation if below)
24	  --force            Reinstall all bundles even if already present
25	
26	Examples:
27	  okf restore
28	  okf restore --min-score 80
29	  okf restore --force`)
30	}
31	
32	func cmdRestore(args []string) {
33		fs := flag.NewFlagSet("restore", flag.ExitOnError)
34		registryURL := fs.String("registry", registry.DefaultRegistryURL, "Registry endpoint")
35		minScore := fs.Int("min-score", 0, "Gate minimum bundle quality score (0-100)")
36		force := fs.Bool("force", false, "Reinstall existing vendor bundles")
37		fs.Usage = printRestoreUsage
38	
39		if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
40			os.Exit(2)
41		}
42	
43		if *minScore < 0 || *minScore > 100 {
44			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: --min-score must be an integer between 0 and 100\n")
45			exitFunc(2)
46			return
47		}
48	
49		if _, err := os.Stat("okf.lock"); os.IsNotExist(err) {
50			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Error: okf.lock not found. Run 'okf pull <bundle-id>' to install a bundle.")
51			exitFunc(1)
52			return
53		}
54	
55		runRestore(*registryURL, *force, *minScore)
56	}
57	
58	func runRestore(registryURL string, force bool, minScores ...int) {
59		minScore := 0
60		if len(minScores) > 0 {
61			minScore = minScores[0]
62		}
63	
64		lf, err := lock.ReadLockfile("okf.lock")
65		if err != nil {
66			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error reading okf.lock: %v\n", err)
67			exitFunc(1)
68			return
69		}
70	
71		if lf == nil || len(lf.Bundles) == 0 {
72			fmt.Println("No vendor bundles specified in okf.lock.")
73			return
74		}
75	
76		client := newRegistryClient(registryURL)
77		restoredCount := 0
78		skippedCount := 0
79	
80		for _, entry := range lf.Bundles {
81			// okf.lock may come from a repository: its ids must resolve inside
82			// .okf/vendor before anything is installed there or rolled back from there.
83			vendorDisplay := filepath.Join(".okf", "vendor", filepath.FromSlash(entry.ID))
84			vendorDir, err := registry.ResolveVendorDir(".", entry.ID)
85			if err != nil {
86				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: refusing to restore okf.lock entry: %v\n", err)
87				exitFunc(1)
88				return
89			}
90			indexFile := filepath.Join(vendorDir, "index.md")
91	
92			if _, err := os.Stat(indexFile); err == nil && !force {
93				fmt.Printf("Bundle %q is already installed in %s (skipping)\n", entry.ID, vendorDisplay)
94				skippedCount++
95				continue
96			}
97	
98			source := entry.Source
99			if source == "" {
100				source = entry.ID
101			}
102			if entry.Version != "" && !strings.Contains(source, "@") && entry.Version != "main" {
103				source = fmt.Sprintf("%s@%s", source, entry.Version)
104			}
105	
106			fmt.Printf("Resolving %s from %s...\n", entry.ID, client.BaseURL)
107			manifest, err := client.Resolve(source)
108			if err != nil {
109				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error resolving %s: %v\n", entry.ID, err)
110				exitFunc(1)
111				return
112			}
113	
114			if entry.Hash != "" {
115				manifest.Hash = entry.Hash
116			}
117	
118			fmt.Printf("Downloading %s (version: %s)...\n", manifest.ID, manifest.Version)
119			// Extract and validate in a fresh staging directory: rollback discards
120			// only what this invocation created, never an existing directory.
121			staging, err := registry.NewStaging(".")
122			if err != nil {
123				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: refusing to restore %s: %v\n", entry.ID, err)
124				exitFunc(1)
125				return
126			}
127			if err := client.DownloadAndExtract(manifest, staging.Dir); err != nil {
128				_ = staging.Discard()
129				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Download error for %s: %v\n", manifest.ID, err)
130				exitFunc(1)
131				return
132			}
133	
134			rollback := func() {
135				if err := staging.Discard(); err != nil {
136					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: rollback refused: %v\n", err)
137				}
138			}
139	
140			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(staging.Dir, "index.md")); os.IsNotExist(err) {
141				rollback()
142				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: bundle %q is not a valid OKF v0.2 bundle: missing index.md (installation rolled back)\n", manifest.ID)
143				exitFunc(1)
144				return
145			}
146	
147			vb, err := okf.LoadBundle(staging.Dir)
148			if err != nil {
149				rollback()
150				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: bundle %q failed to load: %v (installation rolled back)\n", manifest.ID, err)
151				exitFunc(1)
152				return
153			}
154	
155			diag := okf.Validate(vb, okf.ValidateOptions{
156				Strict:   true,
157				MinScore: minScore,
158			})
159			if !diag.IsConformant || !diag.GatePassed {
160				rollback()
161				if minScore > 0 && diag.Scorecard != nil && diag.Scorecard.Score < minScore {
162					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: bundle %q failed quality gate: score %d is below required minimum %d (Grade: %s); installation rolled back\n",
163						manifest.ID, diag.Scorecard.Score, minScore, diag.Scorecard.Grade)
164				} else {
165					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: bundle %q failed strict validation (%d errors, %d broken links); installation rolled back\n",
166						manifest.ID, len(diag.Errors), len(diag.BrokenLinks))
167				}
168				exitFunc(1)
169				return
170			}
171	
172			if err := staging.Commit(".", entry.ID); err != nil {
173				rollback()
174				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: bundle %q could not be restored: %v (installation rolled back)\n", manifest.ID, err)
175				exitFunc(1)
176				return
177			}
178	
179			if diag.Scorecard != nil {
180				fmt.Printf("Bundle quality score: %d/100 (Grade: %s)\n", diag.Scorecard.Score, diag.Scorecard.Grade)
181			}
182			fmt.Printf("Successfully restored %s in %s\n", manifest.ID, vendorDisplay)
183			restoredCount++
184		}
185	
186		fmt.Printf("Restore complete: %d restored, %d skipped.\n", restoredCount, skippedCount)
187	}
